audit: independent algebraic check of the sole C5-T4 claim

definitions_checked.B: z I(G-N[r]), contribution for sets with r present, including z for r
definitions_checked.P_m: independence polynomial of the m-vertex path, P_0=1, P_1=1+z, P_m=P_(m-1)+z P_(m-2) for m>=2

independent_derivation: Partition independent sets in G_m by whether r is absent or present.
When r is absent, the attached path is unrestricted and contributes P_m, multiplying I(G-r)=A.
When r is present, w_1 is forbidden, and the remaining attached path is the (m-1)-vertex path; this contributes B P_(m-1).
Thus I(G_m)=A P_m+B P_(m-1). Coefficient extraction gives Delta_p(G_m)=[z^(p+1)](...) - [z^p](...) for every integer p, with coefficients outside polynomial degree equal to zero.

leaf_interface_checked.old_leaf_v_distinct_from_r: Deleting v commutes with attaching the path at r. Apply the same partition to G=T-v rooted at r; this evaluates the exact strict selector Delta_p(T_m-v)<0 for that tag. Distinct leaves remain distinct tags even when their supports coincide.
leaf_interface_checked.r_if_an_original_degree_one_leaf: Its degree increases by one, so it is no longer a leaf of T_m and is omitted from the old-leaf list.
leaf_interface_checked.new_endpoint: Deleting w_m leaves T_(m-1), including T_0=T when m=1; hence its selector test is Delta_p(T_(m-1))<0.
leaf_interface_checked.boundary_note: For a singleton base tree and m=1, the formerly isolated root becomes a leaf of T_m although it was not an original degree-one leaf. The claim only promises surviving old-leaf tags and the new endpoint, so this omitted newly created root leaf is outside its stated interface.

example_recalculation.base: K1,7 with center r; attach m=1 at r; choose any old leaf v.
example_recalculation.eligibility: x(K1,7)=4 and p=3, so x+2<=p fails; this is not a primary counterexample.

scope_boundary: This proves an exact selector-computation recurrence for the stated pendant-path operation. It does not propagate x(T), alpha(T), lower-region eligibility, the fixed selected sum S, or its sign.
